description: This file is part of the vtiger CRM project and is responsible for handling the saving of mail scanner rules within the settings module. It initializes objects related to mail scanner information and rules, updates rule properties based on user input received via HTTP request, and updates the rule and associated action in the database.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Class handling mail scanner information, instantiated with scanner name.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerRule
classes.description: Class representing a mail scanner rule, instantiated with rule ID, includes methods to update rule details and associated actions.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method that updates the mail scanner rule in the database with the current object properties.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Method that updates the action associated with the mail scanner rule.
